portal.headline: Unified *Lab Learning Space*
lead: A CloudLab-styled course portal where interactive laboratory manuals and the shared knowledge database live together, so students can move from a task to the supporting concept without leaving the course environment.

about.title: Labs and knowledge live in the same student space

cards.title: Course Hub
cards.body: Start page, lab catalog, architecture overview, and student orientation.

cards.title: Lab Manuals
cards.body: Interactive stages, measurements, checks, and evidence capture.

cards.title: Knowledge DB
cards.body: Short reusable articles for concepts, tools, code, and troubleshooting.

cards.title: Shared Assets
cards.body: McMaster styling, diagrams, lab figures, and course-owned media.

cards.title: Future Labs
cards.body: New labs plug into the same shell, reference model, and visual system.

cards.title: Labs
cards.body: Procedures, stages, tables, quizzes, and checklists.

cards.title: Topics
cards.body: Reusable explanations independent of a single lab.

cards.title: Evidence
cards.body: Local student entries, measurements, predictions, and reflections.

knowledge.title: Knowledge Database
knowledge.description: Reusable student support organized by concept family: LabVIEW, circuits, measurement, Arduino, simulation, and engineering practice. Every topic offers a short explanation, a practical check, and a relevant lab connection, so students can search or filter concepts and return straight to the lab workflow.
